argument.anchor: Estimands, task matching, failure accounting, cost provenance and Bayesian information value

illustration.anchor: 76000 assumed expected value; 5200 EVSI; negative net value at experiment cost 8000

estimand: Paired incremental expected decision utility on all offered tasks minus fixed and variable incremental costs; no unobserved causal utility treated as known in public observational data
comparators: best available deterministic/manual/package baseline under matched information
bounded prototype candidate with identical target/loss/failure policy
heldout_rule: Freeze task families, controls, loss model, methods and budgets before evaluation; hold out institutions/histories/templates rather than correlated rows; use paired task outcomes and retain losing/unavailable requests
uncertainty: Respect institution/history/task-family dependence; distinguish estimate uncertainty, transport assumptions, price scenarios and reference-truth uncertainty
